summary: Examples test if /etc/hosts is a file and select file paths from a list.
questions: How do I select only files from a list of paths?

answer_card.title: is_file test examples
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
vars:
  my_etc_hosts_is_a_file: "{{ '/etc/hosts' is file }}"
  list_of_files: "{{ list_of_paths | select('file') }}"
```
